{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u041/system/state/workspace/programs/task-a2689831.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Stack the colored motif to the right of the guide above the lower 1 motif."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row)
    # The repeated 1-shape below the divider is the anchor motif.
    lower = [(r, c) for r in range(divider + 1, h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    # Of the motifs above the divider, the rightmost non-guide object is copied.
    colors = sorted({grid[r][c] for r in range(divider) for c in range(w)
                     if grid[r][c] not in (0, 1, 2, 5)})
    color = colors[-1]
    motif = [(r, c) for r in range(divider) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    lr, lc = min(r for r, c in lower), min(c for r, c in lower)
    mr, mc = min(r for r, c in motif), min(c for r, c in motif)
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(9)]
    for r, c in motif:
        out[2 + (r - mr)][lc + (c - mc)] = color
    for r, c in lower:
        out[5 + (r - lr)][c] = 1
    return out
"
}
